chunks: Sahl ibn Ziyād, from Muḥammad ibn Ismāʿīl, from Muḥammad ibn ʿUdhāfir, from Isḥāq ibn ʿAmmār, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
Condolence is only at the grave; then they depart. No event occurs for the deceased such that they would hear the sound.

key_terms.الْقَبْرِ: the grave, the place of burial

ai.seo_question: Is taʿziyah only at the grave according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states that offering taʿziyah is confined to the time at the grave, after which people depart. It also negates that any new occurrence happens for the deceased by which they would hear the sound.
